final: SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, AVG(f.rebtotal) AS avg_rebtotal_usd, AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / f.feerate) AS avg_rate_expr, AVG(f.rebtotal) - (SELECT AVG(g) FROM (SELECT AVG(f2.rebtotal) AS g FROM fees f2 JOIN orders o2 ON o2.recordvault = f2.orderslink GROUP BY f2.orderslink, o2.ordertune)) AS avg_minus_grand_avg FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune HAVING AVG(f.rebtotal) > (SELECT AVG(g) FROM (SELECT AVG(f3.rebtotal) AS g FROM fees f3 JOIN orders o3 ON o3.recordvault = f3.orderslink GROUP BY f3.orderslink, o3.ordertune)) ORDER BY avg_minus_grand_avg IS NULL, avg_minus_grand_avg DESC LIMIT 10
